description: This PHP source file defines the menu entries for the Surveys module in a SuiteCRM system. It checks user access permissions and adds menu options for creating new surveys, viewing the list of surveys, and viewing survey responses, with localization support.

methods.name: ACLController::checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specified access ('edit' or 'list') to the 'Surveys' or 'SurveyResponses' modules.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a label key within the 'SurveyResponses' module to the current language.
